{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure we start fresh
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_customers = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the fraction who converted
fraction_converted = loyal_customers['converted'].mean()

# Print the result exactly as it will be used in evidence
print(fraction_converted)"}
